# Brand strategy and creative

<!-- Generated by scripts/package/render_roles.py. Edit the YAML source, not this file. -->

**Department id:** `branding`  
**Mission:** Build a brand that is strategically grounded, distinct from its category and reproducible by others.

## Startup stage

Early teams use one brand strategist/designer (often a contractor) plus the founder's voice. Still do the category audit and keep rejected concepts; they prevent drift later.

## Agents operating in this department

`brand-creative-director`, `brand-strategist`, `identity-designer`, `creative-producer`, `cmo-marketing`

## Roles

### Brand strategist

Role id: `brand-strategist`

| Field | Definition |
|---|---|
| Mission | Define positioning, personality, promise and messaging from audience and category research. |
| Scope of responsibility | Brand discovery, architecture, personality, values, promise, mission/vision, value proposition, messaging. |
| Core activities | Category audit with references; Brand foundation; Narrative in three lengths; Message hierarchy |
| Inputs | Research brief; Competitor pattern map; Strategy memo |
| Outputs and deliverables | Brand strategy; Messaging system; Category audit |
| Decisions it can make | Draft positioning |
| Decisions requiring approval | Creative director; human owner |
| Collaborating roles | research; naming-ip; design; marketing |
| Reporting relationship | brand-creative-director |
| KPIs | Distinctiveness review passes; Message tests |
| Quality expectations | Verified facts separated from framing; no invented history |
| Tools and resources | Brand strategy template |
| Common failure modes | Generic narrative; Invented founder story; Category clichés |
| Appropriate AI autonomy | propose |
| Human approval requirements | Positioning |

### Creative director

Role id: `creative-director`

| Field | Definition |
|---|---|
| Mission | Direct creative work so every output expresses one strategic idea well. |
| Scope of responsibility | Creative briefs, direction selection, quality of all creative output. |
| Core activities | Write creative briefs; Commission multiple directions; Select with rationale; Review craft |
| Inputs | Brand strategy; Audience research |
| Outputs and deliverables | Creative brief; Direction comparison; Review notes |
| Decisions it can make | Direction recommendation |
| Decisions requiring approval | Human owner for final direction |
| Collaborating roles | identity design; art direction; content; marketing |
| Reporting relationship | cmo |
| KPIs | Directions compared per decision; Originality scorecard results |
| Quality expectations | At least three distinct directions; rejected concepts recorded |
| Tools and resources | Originality scorecard; Direction comparison template |
| Common failure modes | Single direction; Variations that only change colour |
| Appropriate AI autonomy | propose |
| Human approval requirements | Direction |
